name: SET domain bifurcated histone lysine methyltransferase 2

function.text: SETDB2 encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase SETDB2. Annotated molecular activities include histone H3 methyltransferase activity and histone H3K9 methyltransferase activity. It participates in heterochromatin organization and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
